correctness.rationale: Original equations reduce exactly to the two-dimensional factor dot I=I(beta-mu-alpha-beta(I+U)), dot U=alpha I-(mu+gamma+gamma epsilon I)U on gamma=sigma delta. A unique supercritical positive factor equilibrium exists by opposing monotone nullclines; the exact entropy--quadratic derivative equals -beta(I-I*)^2-[beta/q](mu+gamma+gamma epsilon I)(U-U*)^2 with q=(mu+gamma)U*/I*>0. Properness as I approaches zero establishes full endemic convergence by LaSalle; the driven C coordinate is uniformly damped. Subcritical and critical differential inequalities establish global extinction. Exact rational checker on 2400 tuples supports algebra but does not replace proof.

value.rationale: The equality gamma=sigma delta is exactly the necessary-and-sufficient cancellation surface for the nontrivial aggregate in interior physical states, not an arbitrary numeric slice. It yields a global dynamical rigidity and strict Lyapunov certificate for all feedback strengths, resolving a natural all-gain oscillation-vs-convergence question that the motivating paper treated numerically on its equal-feedback diagonal. The scope is limited to the balanced prevalence-driven subfamily.
